# /crav1-explain-this-code

lane: cross-cutting | group: Keep the picture current | starter: no | stage: stable | since: 1.59.0 | prompts: 3
purpose: Explain one piece of code (a file, a function, a selection, or a PR diff) from reading it.
use_when: You want one piece of code explained
reads: Reads the named file, function, selection, or PR diff and the workspace code it calls. What and why also reads `docs/specs/`, plan decisions, `docs/system/`, and `git log`/`git blame`.
writes: Writes the explanation and a mermaid flowchart in the chat. On Save as .md, after the user confirms the full path, writes `explain-this-code-<target>-<date>.md` to `~/Downloads` (or `%USERPROFILE%\Downloads`) or a path the user names, with a header naming the paths and `<branch>@<short sha>`.
leaves alone: Leaves code, specs, `docs/`, and the rest of the kit layout alone. Never writes into the repo by default.
limits: never guesses; says `not read` for code it could not read and `no stated reason found` for a step with no stated reason. The kit never reads or indexes a saved file.
flow:
- **`/crav1-explain-this-code`** explains a file, a function, a selection, or a PR diff in the chat.
- It opens with one question: what it does (Recommended), what and why, or teach the language, and skips it when the wording answers.
- It reads only the code and the code it calls and never guesses.
- What and why takes reasons only from the code, specs, plan decisions, system notes, and commits, and says `no stated reason found` otherwise.
- At the end it offers Save as .md to the Downloads folder, after showing the full path.
- It is not `/crav1-explain-existing-system`, which reads `docs/system/`.

## Choice words
- question: How deep
  - `what-it-does`: what it does
  - `what-and-why`: what and why
  - `teach-the-language`: teach the language
called_by: Called by the user.
runs by itself: Calls no skill.
you run next: nothing in particular
first: `/crav1-explain-this-code what-it-does @src/<file>`
walkthrough: from-explain-this-code.md
human: https://github.com/Crav1on/crav1-spec-kit/blob/v1.208.0/docs/reference/skills/crav1-explain-this-code.md
